newsitem.title: USA: Access Beyond stake raised by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: Access Beyond stake raised by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Friday it raised its stake in Access Beyond Inc to 18 percent or 2,158,300 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 148,300 additional shares of Access Beyond between January 3 and 18 at prices ranging from $6.50 to $7.438 a share.
Access Beyond is a Gaithersburg, Md.,-based maker of remote access products. The company was formerly part of Penril DataComm Networks.
